english.title: Include in a publication matter breaching anonymity of victim of female genital mutilation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were responsible for a publication, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLICATION..), which included matter which was likely to lead members of the public to identify a person against whom a female genital mutilation offence had been committed during that person's lifetime
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 2(1) and 2(2) of Schedule 1 to the Female Genital Mutilation Act 2003.
